title: Qualify the F8 exit candidate on Android
requires: Physical Pixel 7 Vulkan device and Android deployment access
scope: Qualify only the F8-93 replacement candidate on the registered Pixel 7 Vulkan target after F8-89 repair. Use the installed public producer and shared Gallery; candidate-v10 observations remain failed history and cannot contribute to this verdict.
acceptance: Bind exact source, APK, embedded Vulkan driver, SDK, device, OS, GPU and candidate manifest hashes and verify ordinary API 0.3 sole-schedule creation.
Pass every advertised capability, applicable public case, physical scenario, quality profile, lifecycle/recovery assertion, independent work budget and negative control in plain and validation modes.
Capture all exact pixel7-gallery-v1 workloads with 600 warmup and all 7200 measured ticks retained, zero failed ticks and no workload substitution. Report timing separately.
Pass all Gallery scenes and semantic controls plus background/foreground, surface recreation, resize/rotation, failure recovery, sustained windows and thermal recording.
Publish raw installed evidence and an explicit integration/correctness verdict. Any non-timing failure keeps F8-99 blocked.
Publish current revisioned Vulkan capability evidence suitable for the generated public qualification index.
